Author: Ajay Bhanot

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Pankaj Kumar,Neeraj Kumar Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ajay Bhanot,J.

By means of the the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No. 100 of 2013 at Police Station- Chandauli District- Chandauli under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468,
120-B IPC.
The applicant is in jail since 20.01.2023.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by this Court on 01.02.2023.

The following arguments made by Shri Neeraj Kumar Srivastava, learned counsel assisted by Shri Pankaj Kumar, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant, which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Rishi Chaddha, learned AGA from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
(1). Delay in lodgement of the F.I.R. in the facts and circumstances of this case is fatal to the prosecution case.
(2). The applicant is not a beneficiary of the Kanshiram Ji Shahri Garib Awas Yojna.

entities.text: Kanshiram Ji Shahri Garib Awas Yojna
entities.label: OTHER_PERSON

sentences.text:
(3). The applicant has been nominated to deflect attention Munna @ Manna vs State Of U.P. on 21 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110451254/
1 from the powerful officials who were responsible for the scheme.

entities.text: Munna @ Manna vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (4). The applicant did not submit any forged or fraudulent documents nor did he make any misrepresentation to secure benefits under the said scheme.
(5). The allotment of the said scheme were cancelled in the year 2013.
(6). The applicant was not indicted in any departmental enquiry.
(7). The applicant does not have any criminal history apart from the instant case.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant-Munna @ Manna be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.
The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-ion is directed (i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
